extracted.intended_audience: The Carpentries instructors, assessment team, program evaluators, and contributors interested in workshop and instructor-training assessment
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and resources for assessing The Carpentries workshops and instructor-training programs, including short-term (post-workshop) learner outcomes, programmatic evaluation of instructor training, and long-term impact studies. The repository provides data, code, and published reports to support those assessments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment domains (short-term, programmatic, long-term)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assess learner outcomes from workshops (short term), programmatic efforts (instructor training), and the long-term impact on learners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The repository is organized to support evaluation across these three scopes: short-term workshop evaluations, programmatic assessment of instructor training, and long-term follow-up surveys/analyses. Data, code and reports for these domains are publicly available in the repository.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-workshop (short-term) evaluation
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluation of the impact we are having with our workshops teaching data and computational skills throughout our global community.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes sub-folders with data, reports, and figures specifically related to workshop evaluations (e.g., post-workshop survey reports). Use post-workshop survey data to measure immediate learner outcomes and workshop effectiveness; referenced reports include Software Carpentry and Data Carpentry post-workshop survey reports (2017–2018).

rubrics_metrics.name: Programmatic assessment of instructor training
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluation of The Carpentries Instructor Training post-workshop survey and general assessment of the instructor training program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic assessment should include analysis of post-training survey results and produce recommendations for curriculum changes and improvements to the instructor training program. The repository contains an Instructor Training report (2021) and related materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Long-term impact assessment (longitudinal/follow-up surveys)
rubrics_metrics.description: Assessment of the long-term impact The Carpentries have on learners through follow-up/long-term surveys and analyses.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Published long-term survey reports are included (e.g., Carpentries Long-Term Survey 2020 with DOIs). Use longitudinal survey data and analyses to evaluate sustained learning, career impact, or other long-term outcomes.

rubrics_metrics.name: Open data, code, and transparent reporting (CC-BY 4.0)
rubrics_metrics.description: Data, code and reports in this repository are publicly available under the CC-BY 4.0 license and projects are open for comments/feedback and collaboration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessment work should follow open-science practices: publish data and analysis code, provide documentation (readme, reports), invite community feedback, and attribute using the CC-BY 4.0 license. The repository structure (data, reports, figures, meeting minutes) is provided to support reproducible assessment.
